turns.question: How big was our customer base in Turkey at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: Customers in Turkey (customer country TR) at the end of September 2026: 5 customers to date (everyone signed up by 2026-09-30); if you meant other counts, September 2026 had 1 signup and 2 active customers (with a non-cancelled order) in Turkey. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
